notes.title: Patch 1.015 - Better dreams
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

First patch.

I've redesigned a couple of the dreams to make them a bit easier to do. The uniform colors were are not the best! Feedback received!

Few other fixes:
- Relax mode flow mode no longer shows weird symbols
- Relax mode no longer shows somna earnings
- Tweaked the merging a bit to make it less error prone
- UI fixes and optimisations including spelling/text
- Story age and text fixes, quite a few were wrong
- Fixed blurred textures on some of the books in your room
- other minor bug fixes

Thank you all who got on board early and supported this game! Super apprecaitive!

Hope you all have a great weekend.

If you need any help just drop an email to hello@playne.com or hit me up on discord!

Thanks,
Krish.

notes.title: Demo - Big Update!
notes.content:
I've been refining and tweaking Maya's Dream and am excited to share some big improvements based on all your feedback!

Progressive Puzzles: I've changed up the game structure to start with smaller puzzles that gradually increase in complexity. This way, you'll have a chance to get the hang of things before diving into larger, more intricate puzzles.

New Dream Image: A fresh, new dream image has been added to the game. I can't wait for you to discover it.

Luna has a voice: Our favourite feline companion, Luna, now has a voice! Luna will also now give voice cues through the game.

Powers Unlocked Gradually: In response to your feedback, powers will now unlock gradually throughout the game. This way, you can learn the ropes at your own pace without feeling overwhelmed.

Earn Somna: As you piece together fragments of Maya's past, you'll now earn Somna. These can be used to buy back memories from your past in the form of mementoes and keepsakes.

Room Transformation: As you accumulate Somna, you can purchase over a hundred different mementoes and keepsakes to transform your room. Each one can give your room a unique feel and provide various boosts.

Improved Tutorial System: I've improved the onscreen questing/tutorial system for a smoother, more intuitive gameplay experience.

My biggest thanks go to Gaurav, Gus, Iceless, KalisChilde, Olm, PlaygueDragon, Sinomatic, SkebForty, and Sly for their invaluable feedback. I couldn't have made these changes without you.

I hope you'll love these changes as much as I do. Happy dreaming, and so let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions!

Thank you all,
Krish
